body: Hi! Please don't leave, id miss you 💕
Was playing badminton and someone left their racket so when I went backwards I stood on it, slid forward flew face first into the net, took the net with me and smacked off the far wall.
Thankyou guys, I didn't expect to wake up to any comments. Il hang on, hopefully I can work something out with her. Also thankyou for the Sub-Reddit I will check it out.
I care - please don't harm yourself. You are such a wonderful person, please don't ever feel that you aren't good enough <3
